findings.title: Missing Content Security Policy (CSP)
findings.description: Content Security Policy header is not present. CSP prevents Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks.
findings.remediation: Implement a strong Content-Security-Policy header restricting script execution and resource loading.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header
findings.description: The X-Frame-Options header is absent, rendering the application potentially susceptible to Clickjacking framing attacks.
findings.remediation: Configure 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or 'X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN' on HTTP responses.

findings.title: Missing or Invalid X-Content-Type-Options Header
findings.description: Missing 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' header allows browsers to MIME-sniff response content types, potentially executing untrusted assets.
findings.remediation: Set 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' header across all responses.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
findings.description: No Referrer-Policy header specified. Browsers may send full referrer URLs containing sensitive path parameters.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy Header
findings.description: Permissions-Policy header is missing. Controlling browser features (geolocation, camera, microphone) is recommended.
findings.remediation: Define a Permissions-Policy header to restrict access to hardware APIs.
